provenancePolicy: BIC and RSP packets remain frozen provenance and are not rewritten or deleted.

issues.title: Freeze Reader-First lifecycle, identity, UX, and performance contract
issues.objective: Create canonical fail-closed contracts, validators, baseline evidence, and ownership map before product mutation

acceptanceProbes.assertion: All six owner requirements map to at least one implementation issue and RFA-20.
Negative fixtures reject browser authority, final-only alignment, monolithic normal playback, multiple audio owners, narration Preview binding, and inferred rebuild/critical status.

issues.title: Add server-authoritative project restoration snapshot and durable paused progress
issues.objective: Persist and return one bounded authoritative resume projection for every project

acceptanceProbes.assertion: A clean browser restores the preferred source revision and latest compatible run without localStorage.
Progress restoration is paused and revision/run compatible; invalid checkpoints degrade to readable source state.
Legacy projects select the latest compatible completed run, then a ready source, from server evidence when no saved workspace exists.
Workspace writes require revision/ETag preconditions and reject stale cross-browser updates.

nonGoals: No audio delivery or generation behavior changes
No browser-provided compatibility or browser authority

issues.title: Add bounded source and job summaries with on-demand detail hydration
issues.objective: Remove full source, block, segment, download, and timing payloads from bootstrap/list calls

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Canonical project bootstrap stays within byte and latency budgets.
Selecting a ready summary fetches authoritative detail and never rejects it for omitted summary text.

issues.title: Define stable structural document IR and PDF heading/layout evidence
issues.objective: Represent headings, body, lists, captions, footnotes, tables, code, order, provenance, and confidence explicitly

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Design for the Real World headings are detected against reviewed fixture truth.

The verifier reproduces the raster properties and fixture hash, matches OCR output to scanned_fixture.ocr.txt and the produced overlay to reviewed expected-overlay truth, and unresolved reviewRequired nodes pause automatic Reader narration at their boundary.
A revision-bound structure overlay represents front/body/back matter, hierarchy, disposition, confidence, reasons, and source locators.

Resolving each reviewRequired node creates a new audited overlay revision with exactly sourceNodeId, sourceEvidence, sourceOverlayRevision, reviewedOverlayRevision, reviewerId, resolvedRole, resolvedDisposition, and resolvedAt; unresolved low-confidence structure is never flattened or auto-narrated.

nonGoals: No silent correction of uncertain OCR

issues.title: Generate structure-aware speech plans with isolated heading units and pause semantics
issues.objective: Bind each speech unit to structural source identity and preserve heading boundaries

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Every heading is a standalone speech-plan unit with level/role identity.
Pause metadata never creates fake highlight words or merges heading and body timing.
Prepared/book/temporary jobs consume ordered speech units; the flattened strings.Join planning path is no longer authoritative.
Heading identity, hard boundary, pause, emphasis, locator, and synthesis hash survive segmentation, retry, and reuse.

issues.title: Enforce bounded first-playable segmentation and durable segment publication
issues.objective: Publish a contiguous 4–8 second target prefix before checking and final assembly

acceptanceProbes.assertion: First segment is retrievable while the run remains active.

Every existing completed artifact under each enumerated legacy root is discovered; checksum, byte length, decodable header, and compatibility are verified; valid bytes are copied, fsynced, atomically renamed, and committed with revision-guarded metadata; interruption recovery is idempotent; post-backend-restart and post-host-reboot playback uses the durable object; a valid compatible candidate never becomes artifact_missing.
A job cannot become completed until committed job metadata and playable media are atomically promoted from tmpfs/scratch to durable storage.

issues.title: Normalize provider-native per-segment timing and capability evidence
issues.objective: Capture trustworthy native words/marks when a TTS provider exposes them

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Native events are revision/artifact bound, monotonic, duration bounded, and normalized.
Providers without native timing advertise that fact and do not fabricate trusted words.

nonGoals: No heuristic promotion to trusted word

issues.title: Run concurrent Qwen forced alignment fallback and publish timing revisions
issues.objective: Align each committed segment when native timing is unavailable, using explicit bounded capability activation

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Qwen3 forced alignment runs per segment during narration, not only after final assembly.
Alignment failure downgrades fidelity without failing audio or reading.

nonGoals: No audio failure on aligner failure

issues.title: Version immutable media/timing manifests and bounded segment/range delivery
issues.objective: Make immutable segment entries the normal playback protocol and bound retained assembled-file delivery

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Normal playback never downloads growing partial or full-book audio.

Full audio is available only to explicit export or a negotiated legacy client lacking manifest capability: full requests return 200, satisfiable byte ranges return 206 with correct Content-Range, unsatisfiable ranges return 416 with unsatisfied Content-Range, and all advertise Accept-Ranges: bytes.
Playback manifest entries expose stable index, checksum/ETag, bytes, timeline, source range, timing state/revision, and immutable cache policy.

Manifest-capable Reader selects only immutable compressed segments and never full-audio fallback; route evidence proves the selection; fMP4/AAC is gapless on Safari/iOS WebKit and WebM/Opus is gapless on Chromium/Firefox.

nonGoals: No Reader fallback to full audio

issues.title: Publish sequenced replayable narration events after durable commits
issues.objective: Replace timed full snapshots with monotonic replayable run/manifest/timing events

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Segment-playable and timing-updated events publish only after durable state.
Duplicate, gap, and reconnect cases converge through cursor plus authoritative snapshot.

issues.title: Build SourceSessionStore and deterministic clean-browser Cinema ingress
issues.objective: Hydrate selected source/revision from server authority and open readable Cinema without audio

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Project selection visibly closes/updates the chooser and opens useful restored state.
Cinema deep links resolve project/source identity server-side and survive empty browser storage.

When no server snapshot exists, one identity-compatible browser snapshot may be imported once without autoplay, persisted through the revision-guarded server mutation, and then removed; when a server snapshot exists it always wins; after retirement, removing all browser storage cannot change restore correctness and no workflow-authoritative localStorage write remains.

legacyRemovalOwned: remove localStorage and browser-authoritative workspace writes after server snapshot import/restore parity evidence passes

issues.title: Build canonical NarrationRunStore with replay/snapshot reconciliation
issues.objective: Give one frontend store authority over run, manifest, event sequence, and timing revisions

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Stale/duplicate events are ignored and gaps reconcile once.
Terminal completion never erases playable prefix or local Cinema/playback intent.

issues.title: Build one append-capable PlaybackSessionController
issues.objective: Decode and schedule a bounded contiguous segment window under one controller

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Later segments append without controller remount, cursor reset, or duplicate media owner.
Buffering preserves reading and play intent at the contiguous boundary.

While at least two eligible unbuffered segments are within bounded lookahead, the scheduler sustains 2–4 concurrent requests; sustained one-request operation is allowed only with concurrencyReason exactly saveData, effectiveType_2g, deviceMemory_below_2gb, or active_manifest_has_one_remaining_segment. Seek cancellation and backpressure are transient lifecycle events, never sustained-concurrency exceptions. Never more than four requests are in flight, and lookahead/back-buffer stay at or below 60 seconds with eviction.
Seeking aborts obsolete requests; long-form Reader, Cinema, and Teleprompt waveform UI uses server envelopes and bounded manifest segments and never fetches or decodes a full audio object.

legacyRemovalOwned: remove terminal-status playback controller remount and duplicate audio owner paths

issues.title: Make Cinema own immediate reading and regular narration transport
issues.objective: Start narration from the reader and enable its existing transport on first playable commit

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Book Reading mode opens before a run exists and stays mounted during generation.
No terminal status or final assembly gates Cinema or first playback.

issues.title: Implement windowed trusted-word read-along with fidelity upgrades and downgrades
issues.objective: Fetch/render only nearby text and timing, and highlight exact source words when gates pass

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Trusted-word drift is within budget with zero wrong-word identity on canonical fixtures.
Timing arrival upgrades an active session without remount; failure degrades to phrase/audio-only honestly.

For every cue at or before the persisted consumed watermark, later timing revisions cannot change cue ID, word identity, order, start or end in either direction, segment, or locator and cannot replace or delete the cue; revisions affect only later cues, conflicts preserve the consumed revision, and timing-conflict evidence is emitted.
The 88.7 MB legacy highlight map is never required for Reader ingress or normal playback.

All Reader, Teleprompt, Cinema, and Theatre timing renderers consume authoritative fidelity from the timing manifest or server snapshot; heuristic or estimated phrases remain visibly estimated even when word boundaries or highlight-map data exist and never enable exact read-along, and no renderer hard-codes or defaults timing to trusted. An omitted Theatre timing input defaults to estimated or unknown and cannot claim exact read-along. An inactive prepared-source block consumes authoritative fidelity or remains unknown, never becomes trusted by inactivity, and cannot enable exact read-along.
acceptanceProbes.verificationCommand: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/readalong src/features/reading-surface src/features/teleprompt src/features/cinema src/features/theatre

symbols: Teleprompt cue and word authoritative timing-state defaults
Teleprompt theatre cue authoritative timing-state default
BookDocumentReaderStage authoritative block and word highlight fidelity
TelepromptTheatre omitted timing input fail-closed default
PreparedSourceCinema active and inactive block authoritative timing state

nonGoals: No cue mutation behind consumed watermark
verificationCommands: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/readalong src/features/reading-surface src/features/teleprompt src/features/cinema src/features/theatre

issues.title: Remove Preview Player from regular narration and isolate Audition identity
issues.objective: Restrict Preview/Audition to preview IDs in voice cloning/comparison

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Global Preview Player is absent in Narration Workbench, Reader, and Cinema.
Preview components cannot accept VoiceJob or narration runId.

Local full-clip waveform decoding is limited to voice-comparison or voice-cloning AuditionSessionId clips no longer than 30 seconds and no larger than 5242880 bytes; VoiceJob and narration runId are forbidden, and over-limit clips use a server waveform envelope or no waveform.

legacyRemovalOwned: remove Preview Player from regular narration surfaces and enforce Audition-only identity

issues.title: Repair artifact currentness, rebuild semantics, health severity, and retained-prefix recovery
issues.objective: Derive statuses from explicit identity/compatibility evidence and independent health facts

acceptanceProbes.assertion: The completed reference run is playable and not labelled rebuild/critical.
Missing optional capability or final assembly failure cannot invalidate segments or create global critical status.
acceptanceProbes.verificationCommand: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/status-strip src/features/health-report src/features/operational-status

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Global System critical requires a fresh backend-authored fact with reasonCode exactly backendUnavailable, corruptState, durableStorageFailure, or unrecoverableInvariantViolation plus sourceSubsystem, observedAt, expiresAt, correlationId, and clearCondition; domain-local facts cannot escalate globally.

Critical evidence expires after 30 seconds to unknown, never critical, and clears only when its backend-authored clearCondition is satisfied; frontend status-strip/App inference cannot promote stale, missing, optional-capability, stage, run, audio, text/currentness, or disclosure-blocking facts to global critical.
acceptanceProbes.verificationCommand: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/status-strip src/features/health-report src/features/operational-status

nonGoals: No deletion of valid compatible media
verificationCommands: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/status-strip src/features/health-report src/features/operational-status

issues.title: Decompose application bootstrap/ownership and enforce lazy/browser budgets
issues.objective: Move domain state from App.tsx to canonical stores and lazy-load inactive features

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Project opening does not ingest full source/job/timing/download lists.
acceptanceProbes.verificationCommand: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/layout src/features/navigation src/features/performance

acceptanceProbes.assertion: A 60-second generation/read session has zero app-caused >=50ms long tasks and unrelated shell renders stay bounded.

verificationCommands: pnpm --dir frontend test -- src/features/layout src/features/navigation src/features/performance
legacyRemovalOwned: remove eager giant-shell ownership and eager Reader feature imports after profile evidence passes

issues.title: Prove cross-browser resume, reconnect, retry, repair, and migration continuity
issues.objective: Exercise Browser A to clean Browser B handoff and all retained-prefix recovery paths

acceptanceProbes.assertion: Browser B restores source/run/manifest/fidelity/progress from server authority while Browser A may remain open.
Every implementing-issue performance budget passes on its named browser, network, hardware, cache, and corpus profile with exact raw evidence and zero unowned app-shell long-task regressions.

Backend restart preserves committed workspace/job state and host reboot preserves durable audio; artifact_missing is allowed only after verification proves no valid compatible artifact exists in any enumerated durable or legacy root.
Concurrent stale workspace mutation is rejected by revision/ETag.

issues.title: Adjudicate the integrated Design for the Real World release gate
issues.objective: Execute exact-byte integrated evidence and emit an approve-or-block verdict only; all implementation and legacy removals belong to prerequisite issues.

acceptanceProbes.assertion: A clean browser starts narration, enters Book Reading immediately, hears first audio, and follows trusted words while generation continues.

The exact-byte integrated release gate executes and binds all browser, storage, 200/206/416 range, timing, heading/OCR, recovery, accessibility, and performance evidence for the 1,680-segment-scale corpus.
A completed 1,680-segment run never fans out 1,680 requests, retains all decoded PCM, or decodes full audio for waveform.

The exact-byte integrated release gate compares Design for the Real World scan/noisy structure output to reviewed truth, proves heading isolation and uncertain-front-matter disposition, and records the audited overlay revision.

nonGoals: No Linear mutation without explicit post-Peer owner transition
